viewpoint: Official Babylonian royal inscription associated with Cyrus's takeover
expectations_context: Legitimate kingship is conveyed through restoration of cults and relief of burdens; this is a reading of the inscription rather than a survey of all Babylonian views

viewpoint: Later Greek historian narrating Cyrus and Croesus
expectations_context: The Croesus story stages reversals of fortune and royal judgment; the pyre episode complicates a simple mercy label

viewpoint: Later Greek literary portrayal of Cyrus as an exemplary leader
expectations_context: Generosity and care serve a literary argument about leadership; treat these episodes as Xenophon's presentation rather than verified eyewitness reports
